summary: A cosmetic focus, a three year warranty and implants are strong, but a booking section with no fields and many image typos appear to cost consultations.

findings.problem: The Book your Appointment section appears to show only a Submit label with no fields, and BOOK NOW appears as plain text, not a link.
findings.cost: A patient ready to book may have no way to do it online.
findings.fix: A working booking form with date and treatment choice.

findings.problem: Quick Links such as Smile Makeover, Teeth Whitening and Digital Smile Design have no destination, and Dental Implants and Guided Dental Implants share one page.
findings.cost: Dead service links send patients away from your highest value treatments.

findings.problem: Image labels read Porcelaine Veneers, Inlamed Gums, Gum Dipigmentation and Crown Lengthing, and the doctor appears as Dr. Johnson Ozgur, Dr.Johnson and Dr. Johnson Ozgur.
findings.cost: Spelling slips and changing names weaken trust in cosmetic work.
findings.fix: Proofread labels and one consistent doctor profile.

findings.problem: The page asks patients to check reviews but shows none, and a comparison to celebrity smiles has no source.
findings.cost: Patients choosing a veneers provider look for real reviews.
findings.fix: A live review wall and captioned cases.

redesign: A working booking form and one clear page per treatment.
Proofread copy and a consistent doctor profile.
Live reviews and captioned smile transformations.
